propositions: Offline mapping-config validation must surface load-time errors (non-integer hierarchy, malformed vocabulary blocks) and resolve-time errors (out-of-vocabulary values, unmapped-non-skipped types) as error findings without Jira import or credentials
All-empty projects.<KEY> blocks must be surfaced as warning findings, not errors, during per-key enumeration

Live-drift check must degrade gracefully to unavailable findings when jira-datacenter extra is absent, PAT is unset, settings resolution fails, or probe transport times out (bounded by doctor-side wall-clock timeout)

Live-drift detection must compare configured vs observed vocabulary on status, type, and link axes via the reusable mapping_probe.build_probe reader; hierarchy divergences are excluded because Data Center probe never observes hierarchyLevel
Mapping findings must be kept in their own separate list and rendered distinctly from blocking-edge findings, preserving the contract of doctor.scan() and run_repair iteration unchanged
Doctor-side wall-clock timeout for probe transport must be implemented as a daemon thread with bounded result() call and abandoned on timeout, returning unavailable finding promptly without raising
